instructions.p: Can you guess which outfit belongs to which American Girl? Each character lives in a different historical time and place, with different fashions. We've mixed up the clothing, but all the correct pieces are here for the paper doll you choose. Put together the right outfit for your doll and you win! When you guess correctly, you'll be able to print out that outfit.* Of course, you can also just have fun mixing and matching clothing and accessories!

To play, click and drag a piece of clothing from one of the mirrors on the left. It's a good idea to start with the doll's undergarments and dress her in layers. If you put on a doll's dress first and then drag over an undergarment, it will "disappear" under her dress. You can remove clothing by dragging it off the paper doll or by clicking the "Clear" button.

footnote.p: *Outfits are designed to fit the American Girls Collection ® paper dolls
